reviews.text: Caroline is an exceptional dog walker who deeply loves dogs. It's always a joy to see her arrive on her bike (for me as well as for my dog) and to find my faithful companion relaxed and happy after his long walk in the Bois de Vincennes. I love receiving the photos and videos Caroline sends us during our walks. Thank you, Caroline and Olaf!
I'm starting to get jealous of Caroline, Schipye is so happy to see her! A wonderful girl, much more than just a passerby, a second mother to my princess.
Caroline has been with Molly since she was a puppy, and we couldn't have dreamed of a better person to take care of her! ❤️ …
The cream of the crop! The only person on Earth besides us who can give Jun treats. He waits for her like the second coming every Wednesday 🙏🏻 …

Caroline has been walking Cody once a week for the past six months. After a very positive first meeting in our neighborhood, Cody started going on group walks a month and a half after his adoption. I had spoken to her on the phone before …

My little 2-year-old dog is a Creole shepherd named Süki, and she goes for walks every Tuesday with Olaf, Caroline Liorzou's dog, and other Creole shepherds! So, a gang of Creole shepherds who love getting together to run and play every …

My Tommy is always so happy to see Caroline for his walks in the woods. I was looking for a dog sitter for my dog, and I found someone genuinely passionate. Caroline bonded with my dog ​​very quickly. For Tommy, these walks are a moment of pure joy. Thank you for everything.

Caroline is a colleague I've known for over a year. I'm so glad we share the same passion for dogs, and I recommend her without hesitation. She's kind to them, knows how to handle them gently, and knows how to care for them. And her little Olaf is a real sweetheart!

Caroline walks our young dog Inna every Tuesday, and we are so happy to have found someone as attentive, kind, and caring as her! Caroline creates a real bond with our dogs, and the walks are accompanied by videos, which is a lovely touch. I highly recommend Caroline for her many qualities and her understanding of dogs!
